intro: Gentlemen, Gameweek 2 gave us Man Utd 5-2 Ipswich, Chelsea 4-3 Brighton and Man City putting four past Palace. Josh topped the week with 61 and jumped two places to 4th. Brahmes propped up the room with 30 and sits bottom on 58, a full 40 off the pace. Asher stays top on 121 despite only 41 this week, which is the very definition of set and forget. Ben and Jonny keep 2nd and 3rd, but only 17 separates 1st from 3rd, so the title race is ON. Louie slid two places to 6th and Jack and Jamie each lost one.
motw: Josh, 61 points and the week in his pocket. Gibbs-White got 13, Schade 10, and Foden and João Pedro 9 each. Four players at 9 or more is how you climb two places. Even the Becker disaster couldn't stop him. Absolute scenes.
stinker: Brahmes, 30 points and the wooden spoon for the week. Cunha's 9 was the only thing that looked like a return. Lammens conceded twice and the bench contributed nothing. Squeaky bum time, and it's only Gameweek 2. He is 40 points off Asher already.
bench: Jamie left 20 points on the bench. Horníček got 7 and Hall got 11, both sat there while the subs list collected splinters. Both came in on waivers or as free agents this very week. Signing them and then not playing them is a bold strategy. The bench is where points go to die, and Jamie held the funeral.
red_card: Josh, because Becker got a yellow, conceded twice and picked up 0 points in a 2-2 draw with Forest. It was a rare flop in a 61-point week. Gibbs-White, on the other side of that game, got 13 for Josh too, so he nearly cancelled himself out. Keeping it in the family.
gloves: Jonny, whose keeper Verbruggen conceded four for Brighton against Chelsea and got 0 points. One save in 90 minutes is not a busy night, it's a bad one. At least Jonny still finished 3rd, so the gloves did not cost him the house.

xi.566: Horníček: four saves and a clean sheet for 7. Jamie owns him and benched him. You can't buy that, though apparently you can leave it on the bench.
xi.229: Tarkowski scored and picked up 12 points from the back. Louie's defender is doing the striker's job. Not complaining.
xi.8: Calafiori: an assist, a clean sheet and 11 points. Ben was well rewarded at the back for a gunner.
xi.449: Hall had 11 points and 13 defensive contributions. He is another one sitting on Jamie's bench, which hurts.
xi.426: B.Fernandes scored a hat-trick and added an assist for 23 points. That is the haul of the week. Jamie owns him, and that is why the bench pain is bearable.
xi.399: Cherki scored twice in 81 minutes for 14. Jonny's captain material, in a week he did not need one.
xi.124: Groß had a goal and an assist in a 4-3 loss for 13 points. Ben benched him, which is a hospital ball of a decision. Thirteen points left behind.
xi.480: Gibbs-White scored and assisted for 13 points in a 2-2 draw. Josh's best player of a 61-point week.
xi.12: Saka scored, kept a clean sheet and took 3 bonus for 11 points. Asher's quiet week still had a bit of class.
xi.411: Haaland scored twice against Palace for 13. Business as usual. Louie will take it every week.
xi.165: João Pedro got a goal and an assist and also an own goal, still scoring 9. Josh's man scored at both ends and still made the team. Fine margins.
